name: manual_c2fd21
claim: Enforce a single-use or uniqueness invariant with a database constraint on one shared key, not a lookup followed by a write; put competing actors (abort versus admission, retry versus original) on the same unique row so exactly one wins regardless of isolation level.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19 permit protocol: an abort that looked up absence and then wrote a tombstone raced a delayed admission, and code-only uniqueness let a second permit be minted after expiry; one unique attempt row removed both.

rationale: 2026-10-19 permit protocol: an abort that looked up absence and then wrote a tombstone raced a delayed admission, and code-only uniqueness let a second permit be minted after expiry; one unique attempt row removed both.
